question: If x ∶ y ∶ z = 1 ∶ 2 ∶ 3, then what is the value of ( {frac{{3{x²} - 2{y²} + 4{z²}}}{{{x²} + 2{y²} + {z²}}}} )?
solution:
Given:

x ∶ y ∶ z = 1 ∶ 2 ∶ 3

Concept used:

Ratio Proportion

Calculation:

Let the common ratio be Q.

Hence, x = Q, y = 2Q, z = 3Q

Hence,

( {frac{{3{x²} - 2{y²} + 4{z²}}}{{{x²} + 2{y²} + {z²}}}} )

⇒ {3(Q)² - 2(2Q)² + 4(3Q)²} over {(Q)² + 2(2Q)² + (3Q)²}

⇒ {3(Q)² - 2(2Q)² + 4(3Q)²} over {(Q)² + 2(2Q)² + (3Q)²}

⇒ {31Q² over 18Q²}

⇒ {31 over 18}

**∴ The required value is {31 over 18}.**
